title: A Man Turned A WW2 Sea Fort Into His Own Country 🏴
caption:
A man declared a rusty sea fort his own country 🏴
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In 1967 Roy Bates, a former British Army major and pirate radio operator, took over a disused WW2 sea fort off the English coast and declared it the Principality of Sealand. It has fought off invaders and no country officially recognises it.
Would you move in? 👇
first_comment: A whole country on a platform in the sea. Citizenship or no citizenship? 🏴👇
